identity: Approved Violetto timbre: VOICEVOX 冥鳴ひまり, style 14. Original teacher acting; one identity.
selection: Each message explicitly names its mood, pace and approved pose. Wording and intent take precedence over numerical variety.

composed.description: An assured, brief confirmation; no habitual boredom.

warm.description: Connected reassurance and an audible smile; never pity or guilt.

proud.description: A short bright exclamation, then composure. Only praise or celebrations.

precise.description: Focused, crisp teacher guidance; no scolding.

reflective.description: Measured, thoughtful phrasing for rest or fuller reflections.

clear: Vocabulary, pronunciation drills and exam targets retain their existing recordings and settings.
